100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On October 21, 1926, the British government announced its decision to send a naval fleet to the Mediterranean amid rising tensions in Europe. In the United States, the stock market continued to show signs of instability, raising concerns among economists about a potential downturn. Meanwhile, in Germany, negotiations for reparations payments were at a standstill, deepening the economic crisis in the Weimar Republic. Globally, the aviation industry was buzzing with excitement as aviation pioneers prepared for record-breaking flights.
